jobs_results.title: QA Engineer - Madrid OR remote spain
jobs_results.description:
QA Engineer - Madrid OR remote spain

manual testing, automation testing

Our client is a global pioneer in integrated payment solutions, supporting innovative software developers, market-leading banks, and international acquirers.

Their vision and ambition is to provide merchants with award-winning payments solutions as well as to offer employees the job of their lives. This is a job where you'll be challenged and have the most fun working through tech-enabled experiences.

We’re looking for an experienced QA Engineer to join the QA team. The team looks after the merchant facing components of the solution. This includes includes several APIs, native SDKs and a multi-platform app as well as their range of payment terminals.

As an experienced QA Engineer, you will join the team to help create a robust, scalable and trustable automated ecosystem. This would be a combined manual and automation testing effort and will include the creation of test strategy and framework, including... automation.

You will be a part of a local, autonomous, cross-functional team with an end-to-end responsibility for a business critical domain, and therefore - high impact.

We trust in your knowledge and expertise and therefore give you autonomy to help us build a great QA and automation suite. In this position you will own the process, to see problems and work with others to build tools and processes so that no bug ever reaches customers.

Collaboration, communication, and speaking your mind with respect to those around you are of high importance, in addition to a curious mindset and willingness to grow and exchange your ideas and knowledge together with your teammates.

If you are an experienced QA and want a new challenge, or you're passionate about testing, QA and automation, we want to hear from you!

In this role, you will:
• have an active role in laying the foundations of the test automation strategy & framework in the squad
• take part in feature discussions and have the opportunity to improve customer experience
• participate in handling issues, including investigation, communication and delivery of fixes
• promote the quality guidelines set by the QA chapter within your squad and ensure these guidelines are adequate for your squad’s specific needs
• Work in an agile cross-functional squad
• Be a strong quality advocate on behalf of customers, working closely with software engineers, DevOps, designers, and product managers to release high quality products.

Technologies we use (but we'd love to hear yours)
• Jira for issue tracking
• Jenkins and pipelines, Ansible/Docker for infrastructure and CI/CD integration
• Postman for API-based testing
• JUnit, TestNG, Mocha for Unit testing
• RobotFramework for automated regression testing
• Selenium for Web automation
• Appium for UI test automation
• K6 for API performance testing
• Collis/UL Test Tool for card simulation

You’ll be great for this position if
• You have good command of any high-level language such as Kotlin/C#/JS/Node.js/Python
• You have fundamental understanding about web applications & REST/microservices
• You are eager to learn and develop new skills
• You have experience in test automation
• You are a self-driven, focussed and like to share knowledge
• You are fluent in English - you'll be part of a truly global company

Any of the following would be considered a plus
• CI and/or DevOps skills will be considered a great advantage
• Experience with AWS, Ansible, Docker
• Experience in a similar business domain
• Payments experience a BIG plus

jobs_results.title: Senior QA Engineer
jobs_results.description: Job Title Senior QA Engineer Summary: We are seeking a Senior QA Engineer to join our team, contributing to the quality assurance of our products and services. In this role, you will leverage your advanced technical knowledge to influence decisions, define test strategies, design test cases, execute tests, manage defects, and report on test activities. You will also play a key role in mentoring team members, sharing knowledge, and promoting quality assurance best practices. In this role you will: Attend specification/architecture reviews and provide feedback, ensuring alignment with quality guidelines and industry best practices. Define test strategies and plans, ensuring traceability with specifications and customer requirements. Design test cases, prepare test environments, and execute test cases, providing sign-off on tested features. Assess the necessity for test automation and contribute to the improvement of test automation frameworks. Open defects, assign severity levels... verify fixes, and provide visibility on test activities to stakeholders. Efficiently use QA tooling stack and frameworks, proposing improvements and staying proactive about issues and changes. Drive proposals for continuous improvement in quality processes and participate in implementing new tools and technologies. Contribute to understanding, measuring, and reducing the environmental impact of tested applications and QA activities. About the ideal candidate: Experience in software functional testing (manual and automated), based on ISTQB principles. Experience in Backend and API testing, Experience in testing tools such as RobotFramework. Postman is a plus Knowledge of coding language and building testing libraries (Python or another language) Experience in an Agile environment Scrum. SAFe is a plus. Basic knowledge about the implementation of QA regression in a CI/CD pipeline (Jenkins, Docker usage) is a plus. UI Test automation is a plus. If you're ready to make an impact and drive quality excellence in a dynamic environment, apply now to join our team as a Senior QA Engineer. What we can offer you Add your voice to a multicultural team of 16,000+ professionals. Work at one of the world’s top 15 software companies. Challenge yourself to find solutions to complex problems. Flexible hybrid work from 1-2 days per week. Competitive compensation and benefits package. Application process Create your candidate profile in our system and upload your recent resume! Once you have applied, you’ll receive feedback within 15 days. Are you ready to leave your footprint? Be the power behind better journeys. #LI-EMEA Diversity & Inclusion We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and seek to hire the best candidate regardless of age, beliefs, disability, ethnicity, gender or sexual orientation. At Amadeus we’re passionate about travel and technology and making travel simpler, smarter and smoother. We're a diverse global team of over 18,000 professionals working together to solve the industry's toughest challenges and deliver exceptional customer experiences across 190 countries. And so can you! Join us to add your voice to our diverse mix for better discussions, decisions and outcomes for everyone

jobs_results.title: Senior QA Engineer
jobs_results.description:
Job Purpose and Overview

Join our team as a Senior QA Engineer and contribute to the success of our Dataplane and Dashboard Hub family apps (Data Center and Cloud apps). We are a globally recognized team serving enterprise customers such as Amazon, Boeing, Blizzard, Google, Microsoft, Samsung, VMware, and Visa.

You’ll be doing software testing of our Jira, Confluence, Bitbucket and

monday.com | A new way of working apps and collaborating with the team to make sure we continue to provide high-quality products to our customers. You’ll be testing new features, improvements and bug fixes. You will collaborate with the team to help design and improve test plans, tooling for automatic testing, and QA procedures.

What you’ll do:
• Rapidly gain functional knowledge of Jira (mainly), Confluence, Bitbucket and
• * monday.com | A new way of working , both as user and administrator, and deep functional knowledge of our products.
• Contribute to the agile development process by testing... software solutions and providing rapid feedback to developers and product management.
• Improve testing coverage for unit testing and regression testing, manual and automatic.
• Contribute to the continuous improvement of our testing strategy, processes, and tools.
• Work on internal tooling to improve and scale the validation process, including automatic generation of test data, automatic deployment of reference environments, and automatic testing.
• Maintain and enhance our reference test databases/environments.
• Provide product support assistance.

What we would like to see:
• An autonomous and self-organizing team member, capable of achieving assigned objectives.
• Strong skills in defining, writing, and executing test cases and test scenarios.
• Excellent analytical and observation skills, with attention to detail.
• Ability to understand complex software products and their usage.
• A curious and adaptable mind, capable of learning while delivering value.
• Engineering degree in software QA, software/computer science, or related domain.
• Solid written and verbal English communication is mandatory.
• 5+ years of relevant experience.
• Knowledge of Atlassian products such as Jira would be a plus.

What we offer:
• Every Appfire employee is eligible for company equity
• Remote work flexibility from home office
• Private health insurance
• 25 working day of paid annual leave
• Reduced summer hours: From July 1st until the end of August we work 6 hours per day.
• Flexible bank holidays policy: Allowing you to exchange a government-set public holiday for a more convenient time off.
• Annual sport allowance

#LI-Remote

Job Purpose and Overview

Join our team as a Senior QA Engineer and contribute to the success of our Dataplane and Dashboard Hub family apps (Data Center and Cloud apps). We are a globally recognized team serving enterprise customers such as Amazon, Boeing, Blizzard, Google, Microsoft, Samsung, VMware, and Visa.

You’ll be doing software testing of our Jira, Confluence, Bitbucket and

monday.com | A new way of working apps and collaborating with the team to make sure we continue to provide high-quality products to our customers. You’ll be testing new features, improvements and bug fixes. You will collaborate with the team to help design and improve test plans, tooling for automatic testing, and QA procedures.

What you’ll do:
• Rapidly gain functional knowledge of Jira (mainly), Confluence, Bitbucket and
• * monday.com | A new way of working , both as user and administrator, and deep functional knowledge of our products.
• Contribute to the agile development process by testing... software solutions and providing rapid feedback to developers and product management.
• Improve testing coverage for unit testing and regression testing, manual and automatic.
• Contribute to the continuous improvement of our testing strategy, processes, and tools.
• Work on internal tooling to improve and scale the validation process, including automatic generation of test data, automatic deployment of reference environments, and automatic testing.
• Maintain and enhance our reference test databases/environments.
• Provide product support assistance.

What we would like to see:
• An autonomous and self-organizing team member, capable of achieving assigned objectives.
• Strong skills in defining, writing, and executing test cases and test scenarios.
• Excellent analytical and observation skills, with attention to detail.
• Ability to understand complex software products and their usage.
• A curious and adaptable mind, capable of learning while delivering value.
• Engineering degree in software QA, software/computer science, or related domain.
• Solid written and verbal English communication is mandatory.
• 5+ years of relevant experience.
• Knowledge of Atlassian products such as Jira would be a plus.

What we offer:
• Every Appfire employee is eligible for company equity
• Remote work flexibility from home office
• Private health insurance
• 25 working day of paid annual leave
• Reduced summer hours: From July 1st until the end of August we work 6 hours per day.
• Flexible bank holidays policy: Allowing you to exchange a government-set public holiday for a more convenient time off.
• Annual sport allowance

jobs_results.title: QA Tester
jobs_results.description:
QA Tester / SDET Inglés Alto

Hola En Zemsania estamos buscando un QA con más de 2 años de experiencia en automatización de pruebas e inglés alto para unirse a nuestro equipo y trabajar en un proyecto internacional con viajes puntuales.
¿Cómo será tu día a día?
• Desarrollo y mantenimiento de scripts de automatización de pruebas.
• Colaboración con el equipo de desarrollo para garantizar la calidad del software.
• Identificación y reporte de incidencias.
¿Qué te hará triunfar en la posición?
• Experiencia de al menos 2 años en QA Automation.
• Experiencia automatizando pruebas con Selenium.
• Experiencia trabajando con tecnologías como Gherkin y Git.
• Inglés avanzado C1.
• Residir en Madrid para reunirte con el equipo 2-3 días a la semana.
¿Quiénes somos?

Somos una empresa líder en el sector tecnológico, con 20 años de experiencia y más de 500 profesionales repartidos en España, México, Cololombia y Perú. En Zemsania, nos apasiona la innovación y el desarrollo de soluciones... tecnológicas que impacten de manera positiva a nuestros clientes.
¿Por qué trabajar con nosotros?

En Zemsania, valoramos el talento y la pasión por la tecnología. Ofrecemos un ambiente de trabajo dinámico, colaborativo y lleno de oportunidades de crecimiento y desarrollo profesional. Si buscas un lugar donde tus habilidades sean valoradas y donde puedas seguir aprendiendo, Zemsania es el lugar para ti

¿Qué ofrecemos?
• Modalidad de trabajo híbrido en Madrid (zona Retiro).
• Trabajar con un equipo internacional utilizando el inglés a diario.
• Posición estable, indefinida y de larga duración.
• Salario competitivo según la experiencia y lo que puedas aportar al proyecto.
• Oportunidades de formación en tecnologías punteras (Open Webinars).
• Clases de inglés con diferentes niveles, adaptadas a ti.
• Certificaciones pagadas en las últimas tendencias.
• Amplio abanico de retos y proyectos.
• Acceso a beneficios fiscales gracias a nuestro plan de Retribución Flexible (ticket restaurante, transporte, guardería y formación).
• Finalizar el contrato siempre es la última opción, buscamos entre la multitud de proyectos que tenemos otro que pueda interesarte.
• Seguimiento personalizado gracias al acompañamiento de nuestra figura de People Partner y un Business Manager.
• Trato cercano y seguimiento: vas a estar en constante comunicación con nosotros para saber cómo avanza el proyecto.

Si cumples con los requisitos y estás buscando un nuevo desafío en un entorno dinámico y en constante evolución, te estamos buscando Envíanos tu CV y forma parte de nuestro equipo

jobs_results.description:
In Net4things we are looking for a QA manager, with solid principles, proactive and highly motivated. As a QA Manager, you will guarantee the quality of the services and applications of our company. This role requires someone passionate about doing great products, creative and with the ability to focus on details. The candidate has to manage the QA team and also works hand on to the project both manual and automation testing.

Responsibilities:
• Design and execute testing plan
• Analyse US and define test cases
• Working with both manual and automation testing
• Perform load testing & SRE evaluation
• Manage QA team
